Interface ExecutableMethodWatcher<A extends Annotation>

Type Parameters:
A - The annotation type watched
All Known Implementing Classes:
ScheduledMethodProcessor
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface ExecutableMethodWatcher<A extends Annotation>
Receives the batches of a method watch, registered with MethodWatchRequest.watch(ExecutableMethodWatcher). The reload-aware successor of ExecutableMethodProcessor: it sees what went as well as what came, paired where a method came back in a new generation.
